failures.root_cause: sed called without -e flag causes the substitution pattern s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g to be treated as a filename rather than an inline expression, breaking test output sanitization in sw-code-review-test.sh
failures.fix: Add -e flag to the sed invocation: `sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"` instead of `sed "s|...|g"`
